scientific_integrity: Proof is exact and uniform in every stated integer parameter, while numerical calculations only cross-check finite instances; preexisting Binet formulas and classical character identities are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to primitive-root parameters at odd prime powers with prime at least five; does not classify arbitrary parameters or assert infinitely many primitive-root primes for any fixed integer base. title: Exact prime-power fiber spectrum for generalized Jacobsthal sequences at primitive-root parameters
